name: Frecuencia de Límite Facial
algorithm: Facial Boundary Frequency — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes frequency characteristics at facial boundaries for deepfake detection:

1. **Límite Región Extracción**: The boundary zone between the face and surrounding content (hair, neck, background) is extracted as a narrow strip. This boundary is where face-swap blending produces the most detectable frequency-domain artifacts.

2. **Local Frecuencia Análisis**: Spatial frequency content in the boundary strip is analyzed via localized 2D FFT or wavelet transforms. The frequency characteristics on the face side vs. the background side of the boundary are compared. Different generation/capture pipelines produce different frequency signatures.

3. **Frecuencia Transition Profiling**: The transition of frequency content across the boundary is measured. Natural face boundaries show smooth frequency transitions. Deepfake blending creates characteristic frequency discontinuities — typically a high-frequency step (different noise levels) or spectral notch (frequency content removed by low-pass blending).

4. **Periodic Artefacto Detección**: The method specifically searches for periodic frequency artifacts at the boundary that arise from: (a) resampling/interpolation during face alignment, (b) GAN generator architecture (checkerboard patterns from transposed convolutions), (c) encoder-decoder quantization in autoencoder-based face swaps.

5. **Multi - Orientación Frecuencia Scanning**: The boundary frequency content is analyzed at multiple orientations. Natural boundaries show orientation-dependent frequency content (hair has directional texture, skin is more isotropic). Deepfake boundaries may show unnatural frequency isotropy or orientation-dependent artifacts from the blending direction.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: frecuencia
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante análisis de frecuencia del contorno facial. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente para los sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Zhou, P. et al. (2017). Two-Stream Neural Networks for Tampered Face Detection. CVPRW.
